intro: Call of Fire is an elemental trial in Loch Modan where initiates prepare to commune with the Eternal Flame and earn their fire totem. Guided by Braldir Ashmantle, candidates must gather elemental reagents from local kobolds and troggs to brew a binding fire sapta. The journey teaches that fire is not merely an instrument of ruin, but the forge and breath of life itself.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Bah, ye didn't trek all this way for tales, did ye, friend? Ye seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem.
First, ye'll need a sapta to bind yer spirit to the flame.

I'll craft it--but I'll need two things: fire tar from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north, and a reagent pouch from a Stonesplinter Seer lurkin' in the southern hills. Dangerous work, but worthy of the flame.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Aye, I've near all I need for the fire sapta, friend--just missin' the fire tar and the seer's pouch. The tar's carried by Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north. The pouch ye'll need to wrest from a Stonesplinter seer in the southern hills. These ingredients are bound to flame, as all true saptas must be. Their elemental ties make our craft strong.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Fire ain't just fury and ruin--mark me words. It's life, it's forge, it's the breath o' creation. All things are bound in balance. One force tempers the other, gives it meaning. Without shadow, light's but a glare. Without flame, stone's but cold memory.
Masterin' magic means knowin' when to blend, not just burn. That's true wisdom, lad.
